title: SPIN: BSP Job Scheduling With Placement-Sensitive Execution
motivation: 现有调度器针对大数据任务设计，不适用于BSP任务的gang调度和placement敏感性特征
problem_framing: 联合优化placement选择和调度顺序，最小化makespan，且需容忍执行时间估计误差
key_insight: 通过LP松弛+随机舍入将gang调度约束松弛化，可得近似比保证且对估计误差鲁棒
method_signature: LP松弛(Program 1) + 随机舍入(Algorithm 1)实现placement敏感的gang调度近似算法
evaluation_criteria: makespan降低倍数、作业平均完成时间减少、估计误差下的鲁棒性验证
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: SPIN不适用于短运行延迟敏感任务，仅适合长时运行作业
evidence_for_taste: first approximate algorithm for gang scheduling placement-sensitive jobs
NP-hard to find a solution that is O(log np / 2√log log np)-approximate
SPIN is not suitable for scheduling short-running latency-sensitive jobs
Retrofitting schedulers designed for big-data jobs to our BSP jobs could lead to inefficient executions
to the best of our knowledge, this is the first approximate algorithm
thinking_moves: 先证近似难度下界，再构造可行近似算法
将整数约束松弛为LP，利用舍入技术恢复整数解
用概率论工具(Chernoff bound)量化舍入误差与估计误差的影响
将gang调度约束从严格同步放宽，通过概率保证同步性
cites_own_work: preliminary version titled "Scheduling Placement-Sensitive BSP Jobs with Inaccurate Execution Time Estimation" at INFOCOM 2020
